mapper.select: select t.team_id, t.team_name, t.description, t.owner_id, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, m.role as my_role, (select count(*) from ai_team_member tm where tm.team_id = t.team_id) as member_count, (select count(*) from ai_team_message m2 left join ai_team_message_read r on r.msg_id = m2.msg_id and r.user_id = #{userId} where m2.team_id = t.team_id and m2.user_id != #{userId} and r.id is null) as unread_count from ai_team t join ai_team_member m on t.team_id = m.team_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' order by t.create_time desc

select t.team_id, t.team_name, t.description, t.owner_id, t.invite_code, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, m.role as my_role, (select count(*) from ai_team_member tm where tm.team_id = t.team_id) as member_count, (select count(*) from ai_team_message m2 left join ai_team_message_read r on r.msg_id = m2.msg_id and r.user_id = #{userId} where m2.team_id = t.team_id and m2.user_id != #{userId} and r.id is null) as unread_count from ai_team t left join ai_team_member m on t.team_id = m.team_id and m.user_id = #{userId} where t.team_id = #{teamId} and t.del_flag = '0'

select m.id, m.team_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.title, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar from ai_team_member m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.user_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} order by (case m.role when 'OWNER' then 1 when 'ADMIN' then 2 else 3 end), m.id

select tp.id, tp.team_id, tp.project_id, tp.create_by, tp.create_time, p.project_name, p.step, tp.repo_platform, tp.repo_full_name, tp.repo_branch, tp.repo_api_base from ai_team_project tp left join ai_project p on tp.project_id = p.project_id where tp.team_id = #{teamId} order by tp.id

select tp.id, tp.team_id, tp.project_id, tp.create_by, tp.create_time, tp.repo_platform, tp.repo_full_name, tp.repo_branch, tp.repo_api_base from ai_team_project tp where tp.team_id = #{teamId} and tp.project_id = #{projectId}

select m.msg_id, m.team_id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_by, m.create_time, u.nick_name, u.avatar from ai_team_message m left join sys_user u on m.user_id = u.user_id where m.team_id = #{teamId} order by m.create_time asc

select r.msg_id as msgId, r.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName from ai_team_message_read r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id where r.team_id = #{teamId} and r.user_id != #{userId} order by r.create_time asc

select user_id as userId, nick_name as nickName, user_name as userName, email as email, avatar from sys_user where status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
and (nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by user_id limit 20
select project_id as projectId, project_name as projectName from ai_project where del_flag = '0' order by project_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_team (team_name, description, owner_id, invite_code, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{teamName}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{inviteCode}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select t.team_id, t.team_name, t.description, t.owner_id, t.invite_code, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from ai_team t where t.invite_code = #{inviteCode} and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_team_member (team_id, user_id, role, title, create_by, create_time) values (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{title}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
insert into ai_team_project (team_id, project_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{teamId}, #{projectId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update ai_team_project set repo_platform = #{repoPlatform}, repo_full_name = #{repoFullName}, repo_branch = #{repoBranch}, repo_api_base = #{repoApiBase}, access_token = #{accessToken}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where team_id = #{teamId} and project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_team_message (team_id, user_id, content, create_by, create_time) values (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})

insert ignore into ai_team_message_read (msg_id, team_id, user_id, create_time) values
(#{item.msgId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.update: update ai_team set status = '1', update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from ai_team_project where team_id = #{teamId} and project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: select id, team_id, user_id, role, title, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from ai_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and role = #{role}
select count(*) from ai_team_project where team_id = #{teamId} and project_id = #{projectId}
select team_id from ai_team_project where project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_team_project_repo (team_id, project_id, name, platform, repo_full_name, repo_branch, repo_api_base, access_token, create_by, create_time) values (#{teamId}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{platform}, #{repoFullName}, #{repoBranch}, #{repoApiBase}, #{accessToken}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update ai_team_project_repo set name = #{name}, platform = #{platform}, repo_full_name = #{repoFullName}, repo_branch = #{repoBranch}, repo_api_base = #{repoApiBase}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select r.id, r.team_id, r.project_id, r.name, r.platform, r.repo_full_name, r.repo_branch, r.repo_api_base, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, p.project_name from ai_team_project_repo r left join ai_project p on r.project_id = p.project_id where r.team_id = #{teamId} and r.project_id = #{projectId} order by r.id

select r.id, r.team_id, r.project_id, r.name, r.platform, r.repo_full_name, r.repo_branch, r.repo_api_base, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, p.project_name from ai_team_project_repo r left join ai_project p on r.project_id = p.project_id where r.id = #{repoId}
select r.access_token from ai_team_project_repo r where r.id = #{repoId}
select count(*) from ai_team_project_repo where id = #{repoId} and team_id = #{teamId}
